events.title: Watch the free demo, then play it
events.summary: This stream is recorded gameplay from the free demo, looping all week during Steam Next Fest: real drum rudiments on your mouse buttons, golden notes that climb a major scale, and the exam teacher who notices every miss.The demo is free on this page. The full game, with 40 rudiments and 5 phases, launches on November 2. If you like what you see, a wishlist helps more than anything. Thanks for watching!

events.title: Launching November 2nd — demo at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Drum Incremental launches November 2nd, and the free demo (Phases 1–2) premieres at Steam Next Fest, October 19–26. Between now and then I'll be posting clips and devlogs — TikTok/Bluesky @drumincremental, or join the Discord. If satisfying, rhythm-driven clicking sounds like your thing, add it to your wishlist — it helps this solo dev more than you know. 🥁

events.title: First Development Update
events.summary: Hi! Welcome to the first development update for Drum Incremental. If you're here, I'm guessing you already know what the game is about. So let's get straight to it: Where are we? The gameplay is complete. All 40 rudiments, 5 phases, achievements, the metronome, the Study Companion... everything is working and polished. Right now we're working on two fronts in parallel: QA. Beta testers are still playing through and refining details. Nothing broken, but there's always something to improve. Final
